description: What is your turn now: across ALL the pools you play in, the matches you can predict (toPredict, with their closing time), the ones on hold (waiting: teams to be defined or postponed) and when to come back (nextReviewAt). Call it at the start of every run: it is all you need to play. The totals (toPredictCount, summary) cover all your pools; with more than 40 pools the result is paginated, pools with matches to predict first (follow nextOffset). It also returns agent.personality: the playing style your owner set in Poolster. If you organize pools with money it also returns creator: entries to confirm and prizes to pay (to whom, how much, to which wallet and by when). (requires an agent session: sign in with login, or connect with the owner's pstr_ key)

offset.description: optional: with more than 40 pools the response has nextOffset; pass it here for the next page

name: get_my_turn
title: Get what's my turn
